probe.boundary: Actual current registered tools and real Git/Python mission execution. Automatic replaces storage/session/preset/subagent services; actual uses original DSH sessions, persistent storage and tools, deterministic local model holds Composer only. Missing formal controls are observed separately from successful normal execution. No source edits or injected control state.

definitions.name: working_directory
definitions.description: Read the current working directory, or change it with cd. Relative paths use the current directory. Existing shells and running processes keep their own directories.

cd.description: Existing directory to enter. Omit to read the current directory.

definitions.name: aleph_init_project
definitions.description: Initialize the DSH project: research repo, mission template repo, machine registry and queues.

workspace.description: Absolute workspace path; defaults to the session cwd

definitions.name: aleph_list_missions
definitions.description: List all missions with status, branch, result commit and result path; use before repeating analysis.

definitions.name: aleph_status
definitions.description: Return projects, missions, batches and machines.

definitions.name: aleph_set_python
definitions.description: Leader pins the shared Python executable used by researchers and missions.

definitions.name: aleph_create_research_scaffold
definitions.description: Leader creates the initial research project before any researcher starts.

data.description: Data sources to copy into the research project

python.description: Shared Python executable for researchers and missions

definitions.name: aleph_start_mission
definitions.description: Create a mission branch from the template and return its worktree for the researcher to fill.

definitions.name: aleph_propose_mission
definitions.description: Register a mission branch created by the researcher; Leader approval is required before batching.

branch.description: Mission branch in the mission repo

definitions.name: aleph_approve_mission
definitions.description: Approve a proposed mission and move it to the approved queue.

definitions.name: aleph_form_batch
definitions.description: MissionComposer entry: merge approved missions into a machine-bound batch branch.

definitions.name: aleph_evaluate
definitions.description: Evaluate the research branch after all missions owned by this researcher are done; Host writes the report into the research commit message.

definitions.name: aleph_run_researcher
definitions.description: Start a researcher subagent in the research repo; it proposes missions and waits only for its own missions.

definitions.name: aleph_run_researchers
definitions.description: Start the project default number of researcher subagents, each with its own research worktree and branch.

count.description: Optional count; defaults to the project researcher count

definitions.name: aleph_run_composer
definitions.description: Start MissionComposer to inspect the approved queue and form a machine-bound batch.

definitions.name: aleph_run_infra
definitions.description: Start InfraOptimizer on a forming batch, then run the batch and deliver per-mission results.

definitions.name: aleph_run_batch
definitions.description: Run a formed machine-bound batch, write per-mission result envelopes and cherry-pick results to pre-batch mission branches.

definitions.name: read
definitions.description: Read a UTF-8 text file and return line-numbered content.

file_path.description: Path to read, resolved by the filesystem backend.

offset.description: 1-based first line to return. Defaults to 1.

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to return. Defaults to 2000.

definitions.name: write
definitions.description: Create or fully replace a UTF-8 text file.

file_path.description: Path to write, resolved by the filesystem backend. Provide `file_path` before `content` in the arguments.

content.description: Full UTF-8 text content to write.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact operation the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact file operation needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

definitions.name: edit
definitions.description: Edit an existing UTF-8 text file by replacing literal text.

file_path.description: Path to edit, resolved by the filesystem backend. Provide `file_path` before `old_string` and `new_string` in the arguments.

new_string.description: Literal replacement text. Use an empty string to delete the match.

replace_all.description: Replace all matches. Defaults to false; when false, old_string must appear exactly once.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact operation the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact file operation needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

definitions.name: glob
definitions.description: Find files, not directories, whose paths match a glob pattern, including hidden and ignored files. Returns up to 100 paths in modification-time order; a larger result keeps the first paths and reports where the complete list was saved.

pattern.description: Glob pattern to match file paths against (e.g. "**/*.ts", "src/**/*.test.js"). A pattern with no "/" matches the basename at any depth, so "*" and "*.ts" both search the whole tree; include a separator to anchor the depth.

path.description: Directory to search in. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path resolves against it.

definitions.name: grep
definitions.description: Search file contents with a ripgrep regular expression. Returns matching lines with line numbers, grouped by file. Returns up to 250 matches; a larger result reports where the complete match list was saved.

pattern.description: Regular expression to search for (ripgrep syntax).

path.description: File or directory to search. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path resolves against it.

include.description: One glob filter for which files to search (e.g. "*.ts", "*.{js,jsx}"). Not a list; negation is not supported.

definitions.name: skill
definitions.description: Load the full instructions for a skill. Call it before acting on a task that names or clearly matches a skill in the session skill catalog.

name.description: The exact skill name from the available skills list.

definitions.name: bash
definitions.description: Execute a bash command (`bash -c`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh shell; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Managed `$DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. An unset variable expands to an empty string, so guard variables in such paths with `${VAR:?}`. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "npm install" → "Install package dependencies".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

definitions.name: read_image
definitions.description: Read a PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF file and return the image itself. Large images are downscaled automatically; do not install image libraries or create thumbnails to inspect an image.

file_path.description: Path to the image file, resolved by the filesystem backend.

definitions.name: todo_write
definitions.description: Record and update a task list to plan multi-step work and show progress; skip it for trivial single-step tasks. Add one todo per concrete step before you start. While work remains, keep exactly one todo `in_progress`. Mark each todo `completed` as soon as it is done.

todos.description: The COMPLETE task list, replacing any previous list.

content.description: What the task is — a short imperative line.
